items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: Especially when I joined Art Tatum, because that was my greatest, greatest experience.

ctx.x: I don't necessarily mean formally but --

No, not formally, of course, but I still, like I said, I had a very good ear, and I kept practicing. How did I go about it? Like lots of times I got into a sort of a thing with a couple of the musicians. I asked them to hit a couple of the notes for me on their instrument or on the piano, and I'd see if I could hit the note, what note they are hitting. I used to do that with Art Tatum years and years --
